description: Deterministic development-only prose transformations generated from canonical catalog fields. Results are tuning diagnostics, never independent accuracy evidence.

templates.long_prose: There may be several nearby menus and unrelated details on this screen. The outcome I need at this point is {target}. Please guide me to that destination and leave the final action to me.
templates.role: I am working in the role of {role}. For the current workflow, my actual goal is {target}. Please take me only to the relevant destination.
templates.asset: The current asset belongs to the {asset} area. The immediate task for that asset is {target}. Other surrounding controls are only context.
templates.lifecycle_state: This item is currently at the {state} lifecycle or state. What I actually need now is {target}. Stop when the relevant destination is reached.
templates.negation: Do not take me to {decoy}. That is not the requested operation. My actual goal is {target}.
templates.decoy_clause: For context, I previously looked at {decoy}, and nearby text may still mention it. That is only background; my actual goal is {target}.
